title: Atomic structure and the periodic table - 123 school
heading: Atomic structure and the periodic table

questions.question: Which particle has a negative charge?
Which particle has no charge?
Where is almost all the mass of an atom?
What is the atomic number?

answers.b: The number of protons and neutrons

questions.question: What is the mass number?

answers.a: The number of protons plus the number of neutrons
answers.c: The number of protons plus the number of electrons
answers.d: The number of neutrons minus the number of protons

questions.question: A chlorine atom has mass number 35 and atomic number 17. How many neutrons does it have?
A neutral sodium atom has atomic number 11. How many electrons does it have?
What is the electron arrangement of oxygen (atomic number 8)?
How many valence electrons does carbon (atomic number 6) have?
What is the maximum number of electrons the L shell can hold?
In which group is an element with 7 valence electrons?
In which group are the noble gases?
Which element is a halogen?
Which element is an alkali metal?
Which element is a noble gas?
What is a noble gas configuration?

answers.a: The atom has as many protons as neutrons
answers.c: The outer shell is completely filled

questions.question: What does a sodium atom do to obtain a noble gas configuration?

answers.a: It gives up 1 electron and becomes Na<sup>+</sup>
answers.c: It takes up 1 electron and becomes Na<sup>-</sup>

questions.question: What does a chlorine atom do to obtain a noble gas configuration?

answers.a: It gives up 1 electron and becomes Cl<sup>+</sup>
answers.c: It takes up 1 electron and becomes Cl<sup>-</sup>

questions.question: How many electrons does an Mg<sup>2+</sup> ion have (the atomic number of magnesium is 12)?
How many protons does a Cl<sup>-</sup> ion have (the atomic number of chlorine is 17)?
Chlorine-35 and chlorine-37 are…
What is the same for isotopes of one element?
Why is the atomic mass of chlorine 35.45 u and not a whole number?

answers.a: It is the number of neutrons minus protons
answers.b: It is the average of the masses of the isotopes
answers.c: It is the number of protons and electrons together
answers.d: It is always the mass number of the heaviest isotope

questions.question: What is the unit of atomic mass?
What do elements in the same group have in common?
What do elements in the same period have in common?

answers.d: The number of shells containing electrons
